source.method: Union only native polygon water by source lake/river/canal class in centimeter-snapped east/south coordinates;then rotate into signed model frame. Upstream lake pieces use model datum Y=0,downstream river/pockets use explicitly estimated Y=-55. Retains native shore/island holes;no full rectangular inferred water plane.

limitations: Static illustrative levels derived from the ordinary-picture layout and coarse standard terrain. Main reservoir sample307.003906m;estimated tailwater252.003906m. Native water pockets and operational levels are unverified;no hydrologic simulation or surveyed shoreline contact.
